portfolio.introText: Everything we have handed over and been allowed to photograph — flats, offices, guest houses and shops, almost all of them within an hour of Patna.

lines: Flats, independent houses and duplexes for families who live in them every day — most between 900 and 1,800 sq ft, most finished inside eight to twelve weeks.
The work is storage-led rather than decorative: corridors, bed bases and window seats carry the volume so the rooms themselves stay open.
Small professional floors — chartered accountants, lawyers, clinics and coaching centres — usually fitted around a working practice that cannot close for long.
We phase these jobs so half the floor stays usable, and we do the electrical and networking runs ourselves rather than leaving them to the tenant.
Guest houses, service apartments, cafes and banquet spaces across Patna and Hajipur, where the finish has to survive far heavier use than a home ever sees.
Everything is specified for maintenance first — replaceable panels, commercial-grade hardware, and finishes a housekeeping team can clean without ruining.
Showrooms and neighbourhood shops where display, lighting and stock storage decide whether the space works, and the shutter has to come up again on schedule.
These are our fastest jobs — mostly night and Sunday work, so the owner loses as few trading days as possible.

about.heading: ABOUT THE STUDIO
about.body:
Ashish Interiors began in 2013 with one carpenter, one measuring tape and a rented room off Boring Road. The work has always been ordinary homes done properly — a family's first flat, a mother's kitchen, an office for four people.

We still keep the crew in-house and still visit every site ourselves. Nothing leaves the workshop that we would not put in our own house.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.body: We visit the site, measure everything and talk budget plainly before drawing anything.

steps.title: Design
steps.body: Layouts, joinery details and a finish board, revised with you until the drawings are signed.

steps.title: Execution
steps.body: Our own crew on site with a weekly photo update, so you always know what was done and what is next.

steps.title: Handover
steps.body: Snagging, cleaning and a written warranty before we hand the keys back.

items.quote: They gave us a dated schedule and stuck to it. The kitchen was done in five weeks and the bill matched the estimate — that alone was new for us.
items.author: R. Kumar

items.quote: Small flat, small budget, and still no shortcuts on the plywood.
items.author: S. Devi

items.quote: Weekly site photos meant I could follow the work from Delhi.
items.author: A. Sinha

items.quote: We asked them back for our office two years later. Same supervisor turned up — that says enough.
items.author: N. Singh

items.a: A full turnkey 3BHK is usually 8 to 11 weeks on site after the drawings are signed. Design-only work runs 2 to 3 weeks.
Yes — demolition, plaster, waterproofing, electrical and plumbing are done by our own supervised crew, not sublet to whoever is free.
10% on signing the drawings, 40% at material procurement, 40% in stages against site progress, 10% after the punch list is cleared.

items.q: Why should I trust you with my business?
items.a: Twelve years in Patna, 240 completed sites and a written one-year warranty on our carpentry. We will give you three recent clients to call before you pay anything.
We take projects within about 150 km — Hajipur, Danapur, Bihta and Muzaffarpur — with a small travel allowance added to the estimate.
